chapters.label: Opening
chapters.title: The craft. The whole kitchen.
chapters.description: A kitchen day connects the food, the people and the decisions behind service.

chapters.label: Forecast
chapters.title: Begin with service in mind.
chapters.description: Review expected covers and decide what the team needs to prepare.

chapters.label: Rostering
chapters.title: The right hands, ready.
chapters.description: Review shifts and section coverage. Send the preparation plan to the team before work begins.

chapters.label: Recipe Lab
chapters.title: An idea becomes a recipe.
chapters.description: Set ingredients, cuisine and portions. Develop and refine the recipe, then review the menu cost.

chapters.label: Patisserie Lab
chapters.title: Every component matters.
chapters.description: Develop the pastry by type and technique, with component planning and make-ahead notes.

chapters.label: Cocktail Lab
chapters.title: The bar has a craft of its own.
chapters.description: Choose the spirit base, flavour and style. Develop a drink specification and a batch for service.

chapters.label: Purchasing
chapters.title: Order against what is needed.
chapters.description: Review stock against the target, prepare a purchase order and track what was ordered.

chapters.label: Receiving
chapters.title: Check what actually arrives.
chapters.description: Inspect the delivery against the purchase order. Record accepted quantities and a short delivery.

chapters.label: Inventory
chapters.title: Know what is on the shelf.
chapters.description: Keep opening stock and the new delivery visible as separate batches. Draw from the older stock first.

chapters.label: Mise en Place
chapters.title: From stockroom to section.
chapters.description: Draw the ingredients, record the transfer and organise the preparation tasks for the pastry section.

chapters.label: Production
chapters.title: Preparation becomes a batch.
chapters.description: Work through the preparation and baking stages, then record the completed yield for service.

chapters.label: Service
chapters.title: Ready for the room.
chapters.description: The savoury kitchen, pastry section and bar bring their preparation to service.

chapters.label: Waste Management
chapters.title: Record the loss. Learn from it.
chapters.description: Separate recipe use, usable stock returned and preparation waste. Record the reason and review its cost.

chapters.label: Sales
chapters.title: Bring service back to the numbers.
chapters.description: Upload the sales file and compare what was planned, prepared and sold. Review unsold portions separately from waste.

chapters.label: The whole kitchen
chapters.title: Your craft. A clearer picture.
chapters.description: CulinAIre Kitchen brings the eleven areas into view, from the three labs to the daily operation.
